title: Deterministic template fallback runs through THE governed delivery-injection authority (delegated WOB-bound mission DL_4d48de10 no longer dies FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING)
description: Delegated WOB-bound missions hit the deterministic template fallback (BASE emitted T1+optional T2/T3, NEVER TELEGRAM_DELIVERY) -> FAIL_CLOSED_DELIVERY_TASK_MISSING (DL_4d48de10). ONE helper injectDeliveryTaskForTrueOmission shared by canonicalize seam AND template tail (forge-strip -> proven omission -> servable -> producer-proof -> stamped push). R1: next-FREE task key; template delivery enforces the canonical current-data contract (no legitimate NETWORK_ACCESS gatherer -> FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_NETWORK_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED); no-intent byte-exact; E6 real upstream bytes. R2: STRONG_CURRENCY_RE += 'tuần này|tuần hiện tại|this week'. R3 bounded detector fixes: F5 — bare 'file|tệp' dropped from LOCAL_SOURCE_RE; file suppresses ONLY in input context (local/cục bộ qualifier, source prep trong/từ/from/of/in/read/đọc, 'file input/data'), so 'tạo file báo cáo'/'save the output file' no longer cancels a current-data demand while 'trong file CSV cục bộ' keeps suppressing. F6 — week recency per clause: a week marker preceded by a schedule/deadline role word in the same clause (họp/meeting/lịch/nộp/bàn giao/giao!=dịch/deliver/send/đăng...) binds EVENT time not subject currency ('2020 trong buổi họp tuần này' FALSE; 'thị trường chứng khoán tuần này' TRUE; unbound marker in another clause survives). Evidence: E9f exact F5 goal -> typed fail at PLANNING, zero minted, zero sends; E11 matrix += all mandated F5/F6 cases; 45/45 focused. NO second detector, NO auto NETWORK_ACCESS, no invented gatherer. Untouched: external inputs, pinning, source-stamp, CAS, provenance, fail-closed. Baseline on cf2674c: f4 R5.1-crash.
